The line is replaced by a live slot; an LLM fills it in the background, and you keep working. When it is done you can keep the result, re-run it, turn it into plain note text (**Inline**) or remove it. ## Features * **Instruction lines** — `AI: ` at the start of a line in a saved note. Lines inside code fences, `
` or `<$codeblock>`, mid-line text and a bare `AI:` do not count.
* **Background jobs** — one placeholder tiddler per instruction (`/ai/`), run one at a time through `rimir/llm-connect`; status queued, running, done, error, stopped, interrupted.
* **Context** — the model gets the whole note with the active instruction marked, plus a small tool set (search, get tiddler, help) from your tools filter.
* **Controls** — Stop, Re-run, Inline (keep the result as plain text), Remove. Inline and Remove appear only inside the slot's own note and never in the editor preview.
* **Several tabs** — each tab runs its own jobs; Stop works from any tab (the owning tab is asked to stop).
* **Safe** — protected notes are never sent; in llm-connect allow mode only allow-listed notes work. A scope filter limits which notes react.

## Prerequisites

* TiddlyWiki 5.4.0 or later (JS modules: restart or reload after install)
* `rimir/llm-connect`, configured with a provider
* `rimir/theme` (`rr-` styles in settings)
* Optional: `rimir/doc-template`, `rimir/llm-help`, `flibbles/relink` (keeps slots working when a note is renamed)

## Quick Start

1. Install the plugin and restart the server (or save and reload a single-file wiki).
2. Make sure llm-connect has a working provider.
3. Edit a note, add a line `AI: summarise the list above in one sentence`, save.
4. A slot with a spinner appears where the line was. Wait for it to turn into the result.
5. Use Inline to keep the text, Re-run to try again, Remove to drop it. Defaults, prompt and tools are in the settings tab.

!! Modules

* `lib.js` — all text handling: instruction detection, slot lines, parsing.
* `save.js` — the save hook: finds new instructions, creates placeholders `/ai/` (next free n), rewrites the note, reports orphans.
* `runner.js` — queue, one job at a time, Stop (own jobs directly, foreign jobs via a stop marker), runner heartbeat (10 s), stale sweep (15 s; stale after 30 s plus the sync polling interval), Inline, Remove.
* `startup.js` — wires the hooks, the `tm-llm-inline-*` messages and the timers.
* `global.tid`, `slot.tid`, `styles.tid` — the `$ai.slot` widget, its rendering and CSS (`lli-`).

!! Placeholder fields

`llm-inline-slot: yes`, `llm-inline-note`, `llm-instruction`, `llm-status` (`queued|running|done|error|stopped|interrupted`; `stopping` is only read, from older versions), `llm-error`, `llm-model`, `llm-runner` (id of the owning tab).

A placeholder is written only when its status changes, never by a heartbeat.

!! Ownership

The runner acts only on tiddlers with `llm-inline-slot: yes`. A save reports a slot as orphaned only if its placeholder's `llm-inline-note` is the saved note. Inline and Remove carry the host note (the slot's `<>`, as `note` in the message's paramObject) and are refused unless it equals the placeholder's `llm-inline-note`, or while a draft of that note exists.

!! Several tabs

* Every tab has an id (fresh per page load). While it has queued or running jobs it writes `$:/rimir/llm-inline/runner/` with field `llm-heartbeat` every 10 s and deletes it when it has none.
* A job is live while its runner tiddler (or the placeholder's last status change, whichever is newer) is younger than 30 s plus `$:/config/SyncPollingInterval`. The sweep marks dead jobs interrupted (stopped if a stop was requested) and deletes stale runner tiddlers and stop markers of finished slots; it also runs at startup.
* Stop on a foreign live job writes `$:/rimir/llm-inline/stop/`. Only the owner acts on it (abort, status stopped) and deletes it. Re-run skips a job that is live in another tab.
* On page unload the tab id goes into sessionStorage; the reloaded tab reads (and clears) it and marks that id's jobs interrupted at startup.

!! Flow

# Save hook parses the note, creates placeholders, rewrites the lines to slot lines.
# The runner is told the new placeholders and queues them.
# A job sends the note (active instruction marked) to llm-connect, tools from the tools filter.
# The result becomes the placeholder text; the slot widget transcludes it. The transclusion does not change `<>`, so results render with `<>` = the note.

```

* eggs
* flour
* butter

AI: suggest a simple recipe using these ingredients

AI: draw the steps as a Mermaid flowchart
```

After saving, the note holds two slot lines. Each shows a spinner until the answer arrives. The second instruction sees the first slot's content only once it is done and the note is re-sent.

!! More instructions

* `AI: write three bullet points summarising this note`

<$fill $name="body">

!! Does it work in scoped views?

No. Views served by `rimir/scope` (`/scoped//`) are not supported. The typical symptom is a box `AI slot missing: …` where the slot should be: the placeholder title in the slot line is not translated to the scoped view.

!! I reloaded the page and a slot says interrupted

Reloading ends the tab's jobs. The reloaded tab recognises its own earlier jobs and marks them interrupted right away; if the tab was closed instead, other tabs mark them interrupted once its heartbeat is stale (30 seconds plus the sync polling interval). Jobs are not resumed automatically. Press Re-run.

!! Can I use it in markdown notes?

No, only wikitext notes.

!! Mermaid shows as plain code

The model's diagram is a mermaid code block. You need a Mermaid renderer plugin to see it drawn.

!! I edited the note while a job was running

Editing does not stop the job. Removing the slot line does (the placeholder is deleted as an orphan when orphan deletion is on).

!! Nothing happens in a note

In llm-connect allow mode only allow-listed notes work. Protected notes (for example tagged sensitive) are never sent. Also check the scope filter.

!! A line came back and triggered another run

After ''Inline'' the result is plain note text. If a line in it starts with `AI: `, it is a new instruction on the next save. Edit such lines before saving.

!! Inline or Remove does nothing / is missing

* While the note is open in the editor, Inline and Remove do nothing and the preview shows no slot controls: saving the older draft would write the old slot line back. Save or cancel the edit first.
* Inline and Remove appear only where the slot is shown as part of its own note (the placeholder's `llm-inline-note`). A cloned note still points at the original note's slots: there they are hidden, and deleting those slot lines in the clone deletes nothing.

!! I renamed a note and its slots lost Inline and Remove

The placeholders remember their note in `llm-inline-note`. With `flibbles/relink` installed that field follows the rename (the plugin ships `$:/config/flibbles/relink/fields/llm-inline-note`). Without relink, fix the field by hand or remove the slots and write the `AI:` lines again.

!! A job in another tab does not show

Each tab runs its own jobs. Another tab sees them only after a sync poll (`$:/config/SyncPollingInterval`, 60 seconds by default).

!! Stop in another tab says stopping…

Stop in a tab that does not own the job writes a stop request `$:/rimir/llm-inline/stop/`; the slot shows ''stopping…''. The owning tab picks the request up on its next sync poll, aborts the request, marks the slot stopped and deletes the request. Pressing Stop again changes nothing. If the owning tab is gone (heartbeat older than 30 seconds plus the sync interval), Stop marks the slot stopped directly. Re-run of a job that is still live in another tab is ignored.

<$fill $name="body">

!! What it does

Write `AI: ` at the start of a line in a note and save. The plugin replaces the line with `<$ai.slot tiddler="/ai/1"/>`, a live slot backed by a placeholder tiddler. A background job sends the note to an LLM through `rimir/llm-connect` and writes the answer into the placeholder. You can keep editing or leave the note.

!! Controls

* ''Stop'' while a job is queued or running.
* ''Re-run'' once done, stopped or failed.
* ''Inline'' replaces the slot line with the result as plain note text.
* ''Remove'' deletes the slot and its line.
* Inline and Remove are offered only where the slot is shown as part of its own note, and not while the note is open in the editor. The editor preview shows no controls at all.

!! Rules

* Only saved notes in the scope filter react. Protected notes are never sent.
* Instructions inside code fences, `
` or `<$codeblock>` are ignored.
* One job runs at a time per wiki tab; the rest wait as queued.

!! Config tiddlers

|!Title |!Default |!Meaning |
|`$:/config/rimir/llm-inline/scope-filter` |`[!is[system]]` |Notes that react |
|`.../system-prompt` |see settings |Prompt for every job |
|`.../provider` |empty |llm-connect provider |
|`.../model` |empty |Model |
|`.../tools` |search_tiddlers, get_tiddler, llm_help |Tools offered; empty = none |

|`.../delete-orphans` |`yes` |Delete slots whose line is gone |
|`$:/config/flibbles/relink/fields/llm-inline-note` |`title` |Lets relink update the placeholders when a note is renamed |

!! Runtime tiddlers

|!Title |!Written by |!Meaning |
|`/ai/` |save hook, runner |Placeholder (fields see Architecture) |
|`$:/rimir/llm-inline/runner/` |the tab itself |Heartbeat (`llm-heartbeat`, ms) while the tab has queued/running jobs; deleted when it has none |
|`$:/rimir/llm-inline/stop/` |a tab that does not own the job |Stop request; the owner acts on it and deletes it |
|`$:/state/rimir/llm-inline/edit/` |slot UI |Instruction editor open (not synced); deleted with the placeholder |

!! Messages

|!Message |!Param |!paramObject |
|`tm-llm-inline-run` |placeholder title | |
|`tm-llm-inline-stop` |placeholder title | |
|`tm-llm-inline-inline` |placeholder title |`note` = host note (required) |
|`tm-llm-inline-remove` |placeholder title |`note` = host note (required) |

All messages are ignored for titles that are not placeholders (`llm-inline-slot: yes`). Inline and Remove are ignored unless `note` equals the placeholder's `llm-inline-note` and no draft of that note exists.

!! Syntax

* Instruction: `^AI:[ \t]+(\S.*)$`
* Slot line: `<$ai.slot tiddler="/ai/"/>`

title: $:/plugins/rimir/llm-inline/lib
type: application/javascript
module-type: library

Pure helpers for llm-inline: marker detection, slot lines, context building.

\*/
(function() {

"use strict";

var MARKER_RE = /^AI:[ \t]+(\S.*)$/;
var SLOT_RE = /^\s*<\$ai\.slot\s+tiddler=(?:"""([\s\S]*?)"""|"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)')\s*\/>\s*$/;

/*
Returns true for each line index that lies inside a fence, 
 or <$codeblock> block.
*/
function codeLineFlags(lines) {
	var flags = [], closer = null, i, line;
	for(i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
		line = lines[i];
		if(closer === "fence") {
			flags.push(true);
			if(/^```/.test(line)) { closer = null; }
		} else if(closer) {
			flags.push(true);
			if(line.indexOf(closer) !== -1) { closer = null; }
		} else if(/^```/.test(line)) {
			flags.push(true);
			closer = "fence";
		} else if(/^\s*]/.test(line) || /^\s*") === -1) { closer = "
"; }
		} else if(/^\s*<\$codeblock[\s>\/]/.test(line)) {
			flags.push(true);
			if(!/\/>\s*$/.test(line) && line.indexOf("") === -1) { closer = ""; }
		} else {
			flags.push(false);
		}
	}
	return flags;
}

exports.findMarkers = function(text) {
	var lines = (text || "").split("\n"), flags = codeLineFlags(lines), out = [], i, m;
	for(i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
		if(flags[i]) { continue; }
		m = MARKER_RE.exec(lines[i].replace(/\r$/, ""));
		if(m) {
			out.push({lineIndex: i, line: lines[i], instruction: m[1].trim()});
		}
	}
	return out;
};

exports.slotLine = function(title) {
	var q;
	if(title.indexOf("\"") === -1) { q = "\""; }
	else if(title.indexOf("'") === -1) { q = "'"; }
	else { q = "\"\"\""; }
	return "<$ai.slot tiddler=" + q + title + q + "/>";
};

exports.parseSlots = function(text) {
	var lines = (text || "").split("\n"), out = [], i, m;
	for(i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
		m = SLOT_RE.exec(lines[i].replace(/\r$/, ""));
		if(m) {
			out.push({lineIndex: i, title: m[1] !== undefined ? m[1] : (m[2] !== undefined ? m[2] : m[3])});
		}
	}
	return out;
};

exports.nextSlotTitle = function(note, exists, reserved) {
	var n = 1, t;
	reserved = reserved || [];
	for(;;) {
		t = note + "/ai/" + n;
		if(!exists(t) && reserved.indexOf(t) === -1) { return t; }
		n++;
	}
};

exports.replaceLine = function(text, lineIndex, replacement) {
	var lines = text.split("\n");
	if(lineIndex < 0 || lineIndex >= lines.length) { return text; }
	if(replacement === null) { lines.splice(lineIndex, 1); }
	else { lines[lineIndex] = replacement; }
	return lines.join("\n");
};

exports.findSlotLine = function(text, placeholderTitle) {
	var slots = exports.parseSlots(text), i;
	for(i = 0; i < slots.length; i++) {
		if(slots[i].title === placeholderTitle) { return slots[i].lineIndex; }
	}
	return -1;
};

exports.buildContext = function(noteText, activeTitle, getSlot) {
	var lines = (noteText || "").split("\n"), out = [], i, m, title, slot;
	for(i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
		m = SLOT_RE.exec(lines[i].replace(/\r$/, ""));
		if(!m) { out.push(lines[i]); continue; }
		title = m[1] !== undefined ? m[1] : (m[2] !== undefined ? m[2] : m[3]);
		slot = getSlot(title);
		if(!slot) { continue; }
		if(title === activeTitle) {
			out.push("⟦ACTIVE INSTRUCTION⟧ AI: " + slot.instruction + " ⟦/ACTIVE INSTRUCTION⟧");
		} else {
			out.push("AI: " + slot.instruction + "\n" + (slot.status === "done" ? (slot.text || "") : "(pending)"));
		}
	}
	return out.join("\n");
};

exports.orphanedSlots = function(oldText, newText) {
	var present = {};
	exports.parseSlots(newText).forEach(function(s) { present[s.title] = true; });
	return exports.parseSlots(oldText).map(function(s) { return s.title; }).filter(function(t) { return !present[t]; });
};

exports.isTitleProtected = function(title, protection, wiki) {
	var filter = ((protection && protection.filter) || "").trim();
	var mode = protection && protection.mode === "allow" ? "allow" : "deny";
	if(!filter) { return mode === "allow"; }
	var result = wiki.filterTiddlers(filter);
	// A broken protection filter must never let a note through: fail closed.
	for(var i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
		if(/^filter error/i.test(result[i])) { return true; }
	}
	var inList = result.indexOf(title) !== -1;
	return mode === "allow" ? !inList : inList;
};

/*
Coerce whatever the orchestrator resolved into result text: strings as-is, content-block arrays
(text parts joined by a blank line), objects with text/content, everything else stringified.
*/
exports.resultText = function(value) {
	if(value === null || value === undefined) { return ""; }
	if(typeof value === "string") { return value; }
	if(Array.isArray(value)) {
		return value.map(function(part) {
			if(typeof part === "string") { return part; }
			return part && typeof part.text === "string" && (!part.type || part.type === "text") ? part.text : "";
		}).filter(function(t) { return t !== ""; }).join("\n\n");
	}
	if(typeof value === "object") {
		if(typeof value.text === "string") { return value.text; }
		if(typeof value.content === "string" || Array.isArray(value.content)) { return exports.resultText(value.content); }
		try { return JSON.stringify(value); } catch(e) { return ""; }
	}
	return String(value);
};

// Copy of a protection object with llm-help's default context as helpContext,
// so the llm_help tool doesn't fall back to the last chat's active context.
exports.withHelpContext = function(protection, wiki) {
	var result = $tw.utils.extend({}, protection);
	var ctx = (wiki.getTiddlerText("$:/config/rimir/llm-help/default-context") || "").trim();
	if(ctx) {
		result.helpContext = ctx;
	}
	return result;
};

})();

!! Features

* ''Instruction lines'' — `AI: ` at the start of a line in a saved note. Lines inside code fences, `
` or `<$codeblock>`, mid-line text and a bare `AI:` do not count.
* ''Background jobs'' — one placeholder tiddler per instruction (`/ai/`), run one at a time through `rimir/llm-connect`; status queued, running, done, error, stopped, interrupted.
* ''Context'' — the model gets the whole note with the active instruction marked, plus a small tool set (search, get tiddler, help) from your tools filter.
* ''Controls'' — Stop, Re-run, Inline (keep the result as plain text), Remove. Inline and Remove appear only inside the slot's own note and never in the editor preview.
* ''Several tabs'' — each tab runs its own jobs; Stop works from any tab (the owning tab is asked to stop).
* ''Safe'' — protected notes are never sent; in llm-connect allow mode only allow-listed notes work. A scope filter limits which notes react.

!! Prerequisites

* TiddlyWiki 5.4.0 or later (JS modules: restart or reload after install)
* `rimir/llm-connect`, configured with a provider
* `rimir/theme` (`rr-` styles in settings)
* Optional: `rimir/doc-template`, `rimir/llm-help`, `flibbles/relink` (keeps slots working when a note is renamed)

!! Quick Start

# Install the plugin and restart the server (or save and reload a single-file wiki).
# Make sure llm-connect has a working provider.
# Edit a note, add a line `AI: summarise the list above in one sentence`, save.
# A slot with a spinner appears where the line was. Wait for it to turn into the result.
# Use Inline to keep the text, Re-run to try again, Remove to drop it. Defaults, prompt and tools are in the settings tab.

title: $:/plugins/rimir/llm-inline/runner
type: application/javascript
module-type: library

Job runner for llm-inline: FIFO queue (one job at a time), stop, liveness, stale sweep, protection.
Pure and injectable: all environment access goes through deps.

Cross-tab model (all tiddlers below are synced like any other tiddler):
- A placeholder is written only on status changes; `llm-runner` names the owning tab.
- Liveness: one tiddler per tab, $:/rimir/llm-inline/runner/ (field llm-heartbeat), written
  every 10 s while the tab has queued/running jobs and deleted when it has none.
- Foreign Stop: another tab writes $:/rimir/llm-inline/stop/; only the owner acts on it
  (abort, status stopped) and deletes it. The owner never writes the marker otherwise.

\*/
(function() {

"use strict";

var lib = require("$:/plugins/rimir/llm-inline/lib");

var STALE_MS = 30000;
var SYNC_TITLE = "$:/config/SyncPollingInterval";
var SYNC_DEFAULT = 60000;
var ORPHANS_TITLE = "$:/config/rimir/llm-inline/delete-orphans";
var RUNNER_PREFIX = "$:/rimir/llm-inline/runner/";
var STOP_PREFIX = "$:/rimir/llm-inline/stop/";
var EDIT_PREFIX = "$:/state/rimir/llm-inline/edit/";
var LIVE = {queued: true, running: true, stopping: true};

exports.RUNNER_PREFIX = RUNNER_PREFIX;
exports.STOP_PREFIX = STOP_PREFIX;

function logError(msg, e) {
	if(typeof console !== "undefined") { console.error("llm-inline: " + msg, e); }
}

exports.createRunner = function(deps) {
	var wiki = deps.wiki, tabId = deps.tabId;
	var createAbortController = deps.createAbortController || function() { return new AbortController(); };
	var jobs = {};        // title -> job (own queued/running jobs)
	var queue = [];       // titles waiting
	var current = null;   // job currently running

	function fieldsOf(title) {
		var t = wiki.getTiddler(title);
		return t ? t.fields : null;
	}
	// Fields of a real placeholder, or null: the runner never acts on any other tiddler.
	function placeholder(title) {
		var f = fieldsOf(title);
		return f && f["llm-inline-slot"] === "yes" ? f : null;
	}
	function nowDate() { return new Date(deps.now()); }
	function write(title, fields) {
		var existing = wiki.getTiddler(title);
		if(!existing) { return; }
		wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler(existing, fields, {modified: nowDate()}));
	}
	function removeIfExists(title) {
		if(wiki.tiddlerExists(title)) { wiki.deleteTiddler(title); }
	}
	function hasJobs() { return Object.keys(jobs).length > 0; }

	// ---- liveness ----
	function touchRunner() {
		wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler({title: RUNNER_PREFIX + tabId, "llm-runner": tabId, "llm-heartbeat": String(deps.now())}));
	}
	function clearRunner() { removeIfExists(RUNNER_PREFIX + tabId); }
	// Heartbeats from other tabs arrive via the syncer, so allow for its polling lag.
	function staleAfter() {
		var lag = parseInt((wiki.getTiddlerText(SYNC_TITLE) || "").trim(), 10);
		return STALE_MS + (isNaN(lag) || lag < 0 ? SYNC_DEFAULT : lag);
	}
	function fresh(ref) { return !isNaN(ref) && (deps.now() - ref) <= staleAfter(); }
	function heartbeatOf(runnerId) {
		var rt = fieldsOf(RUNNER_PREFIX + runnerId);
		return rt ? parseInt(rt["llm-heartbeat"], 10) : NaN;
	}
	// Newest liveness signal of a job: its runner tiddler's heartbeat, or the placeholder's last
	// status change (covers the moment before the runner tiddler has synced). NaN = no signal.
	function lastSign(f) {
		var ref = $tw.utils.isDate(f.modified) ? f.modified.getTime() : NaN;
		var hb = f["llm-runner"] ? heartbeatOf(f["llm-runner"]) : NaN;
		if(!isNaN(hb) && (isNaN(ref) || hb > ref)) { ref = hb; }
		return ref;
	}
	// True when another tab owns this live job and is alive.
	function liveElsewhere(f) {
		var r = f["llm-runner"];
		return !!LIVE[f["llm-status"]] && !!r && r !== tabId && fresh(lastSign(f));
	}

	// ---- job bookkeeping ----
	function release(job) {
		if(jobs[job.title] === job) { delete jobs[job.title]; }
		var qi = queue.indexOf(job.title);
		if(qi !== -1 && job.state === "queued") { queue.splice(qi, 1); }
		if(current === job) { current = null; pump(); }
		if(!hasJobs()) { clearRunner(); }
	}
	// Abort/drop own job (no placeholder write).
	function drop(title) {
		var job = jobs[title];
		if(!job) { return null; }
		job.dropped = true;
		if(job.controller) { job.controller.abort(); }
		release(job);
		return job;
	}
	function deletePlaceholder(title) {
		wiki.deleteTiddler(title);
		removeIfExists(EDIT_PREFIX + title);
		removeIfExists(STOP_PREFIX + title);
	}
	// A dead job (no live owner): stopped if a stop was requested, else interrupted.
	function markDead(title, f) {
		var stopRequested = f["llm-status"] === "stopping" || wiki.tiddlerExists(STOP_PREFIX + title);
		write(title, {"llm-status": stopRequested ? "stopped" : "interrupted"});
		removeIfExists(STOP_PREFIX + title);
	}
	function finishWith(job, fields) {
		try {
			var f = placeholder(job.title);
			if(f && jobs[job.title] === job && f["llm-status"] === "running" && f["llm-runner"] === tabId) {
				write(job.title, fields);
			}
		} catch(e) {
			logError("finishing job failed", e);
		} finally {
			release(job);
		}
	}
	function fail(job, err) {
		try {
			if(jobs[job.title] === job && placeholder(job.title)) {
				write(job.title, {"llm-status": "error", "llm-error": (err && err.message) || String(err)});
			}
		} catch(e) {
			logError("recording job error failed", e);
		} finally {
			release(job);
		}
	}

	function pump() {
		var title, job, f;
		if(current) { return; }
		while(queue.length) {
			title = queue.shift();
			job = jobs[title];
			if(!job) { continue; }
			f = placeholder(title);
			if(!f || f["llm-status"] !== "queued" || f["llm-runner"] !== tabId) { delete jobs[title]; continue; }
			current = job;
			job.state = "running";
			try {
				start(job);
			} catch(e) {
				// Nothing before the request may wedge the queue.
				fail(job, e);
			}
			return;
		}
		if(!hasJobs()) { clearRunner(); }
	}

	function start(job) {
		var title = job.title, f = placeholder(title), noteTitle = f["llm-inline-note"], noteTiddler = wiki.getTiddler(noteTitle);
		if(!noteTiddler) {
			write(title, {"llm-status": "error", "llm-error": "note not found"});
			release(job);
			return;
		}
		var protection = deps.getProtection();
		if(lib.isTitleProtected(noteTitle, protection, wiki)) {
			write(title, {"llm-status": "error", "llm-error": "note is protected from the LLM"});
			release(job);
			return;
		}
		write(title, {"llm-status": "running", "llm-error": ""});
		var promise;
		try {
			var run = deps.buildRunOptions();
			job.controller = createAbortController();
			var prompt = lib.buildContext(noteTiddler.fields.text || "", title, function(t) {
				var s = placeholder(t);
				return s ? {instruction: s["llm-instruction"] || "", status: s["llm-status"], text: s.text || ""} : null;
			});
			job.model = (run.config.provider || "") + "/" + (run.config.model || "");
			promise = Promise.resolve(deps.runAction({
				prompt: prompt, config: run.config, adapter: run.adapter, toolExecutor: run.toolExecutor,
				tools: run.tools, protectionFilter: protection, signal: job.controller.signal
			}));
		} catch(e) {
			promise = Promise.reject(e);
		}
		promise.then(function(result) {
			finishWith(job, {text: lib.resultText(result), "llm-status": "done", "llm-error": "", "llm-model": job.model});
		}, function(err) {
			var aborted = job.controller && job.controller.signal && job.controller.signal.aborted;
			finishWith(job, aborted ? {"llm-status": "stopped"} : {"llm-status": "error", "llm-error": (err && err.message) || String(err)});
		});
	}

	var api = {};

	api.enqueue = function(titles) {
		var added = false;
		titles.forEach(function(title) {
			var f = placeholder(title);
			// Not a placeholder, already ours, or live in another tab: nothing to do.
			if(!f || jobs[title] || liveElsewhere(f)) { return; }
			write(title, {"llm-status": "queued", "llm-runner": tabId, "llm-error": ""});
			removeIfExists(STOP_PREFIX + title);
			jobs[title] = {title: title, state: "queued"};
			queue.push(title);
			added = true;
		});
		if(added) { touchRunner(); }
		pump();
	};

	api.stop = function(title) {
		var f = placeholder(title);
		if(!f || !LIVE[f["llm-status"]]) { return; }
		if(jobs[title] && f["llm-runner"] === tabId) {
			write(title, {"llm-status": "stopped"});
			removeIfExists(STOP_PREFIX + title);
			drop(title);
		} else if(liveElsewhere(f)) {
			// Ask the owner; never write its placeholder. A repeated Stop changes nothing.
			if(!wiki.tiddlerExists(STOP_PREFIX + title)) {
				wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler({title: STOP_PREFIX + title, "llm-stop": title, "llm-runner": tabId}));
			}
		} else {
			write(title, {"llm-status": "stopped"});
			removeIfExists(STOP_PREFIX + title);
		}
	};

	api.onChange = function(changes) {
		Object.keys(changes).forEach(function(title) {
			var f, target;
			if(title.indexOf(STOP_PREFIX) === 0) {
				if(!wiki.tiddlerExists(title)) { return; }
				target = title.slice(STOP_PREFIX.length);
				f = placeholder(target);
				if(!f || f["llm-runner"] !== tabId) { return; }
				// Only the owner acts on (and deletes) a stop marker.
				if(LIVE[f["llm-status"]]) { write(target, {"llm-status": "stopped"}); }
				drop(target);
				wiki.deleteTiddler(title);
				return;
			}
			if(!jobs[title]) { return; }
			f = placeholder(title);
			if(!f || f["llm-runner"] !== tabId || (f["llm-status"] !== "queued" && f["llm-status"] !== "running")) {
				// Deleted, or changed from outside (another tab took over or marked it): let go.
				drop(title);
			}
		});
	};

	api.removeOrphans = function(titles, note) {
		var del = (wiki.getTiddlerText(ORPHANS_TITLE, "yes") || "").trim() === "yes";
		titles.forEach(function(title) {
			var f = placeholder(title);
			if(!f || f["llm-inline-note"] !== note) { return; }
			if(LIVE[f["llm-status"]] && jobs[title]) { write(title, {"llm-status": "stopped"}); }
			drop(title);
			if(del) { deletePlaceholder(title); }
		});
	};

	// Placeholder that Inline/Remove may edit: it must belong to the host note the slot is
	// rendered in, and that note must not be open in the editor (saving the draft would undo it).
	function editable(title, host) {
		var f = placeholder(title);
		if(!f || !host || f["llm-inline-note"] !== host || wiki.findDraft(host)) { return null; }
		return f;
	}
	function editNote(title, f, replacement) {
		var note = wiki.getTiddler(f["llm-inline-note"]);
		if(!note) { return false; }
		var text = note.fields.text || "";
		var idx = lib.findSlotLine(text, title);
		if(idx === -1) { return false; }
		drop(title);
		wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler(note, {text: lib.replaceLine(text, idx, replacement), modified: nowDate()}));
		deletePlaceholder(title);
		return true;
	}

	api.inline = function(title, host) {
		var f = editable(title, host);
		if(!f || f["llm-status"] !== "done") { return; }
		editNote(title, f, f.text || "");
	};

	api.remove = function(title, host) {
		var f = editable(title, host);
		if(!f) { return; }
		if(!editNote(title, f, null)) {
			// Slot line already gone from the note: still drop job and placeholder.
			drop(title);
			deletePlaceholder(title);
		}
	};

	api.heartbeat = function() {
		if(hasJobs()) { touchRunner(); } else { clearRunner(); }
	};

	api.sweepStale = function() {
		wiki.filterTiddlers("[all[tiddlers]field:llm-inline-slot[yes]]").forEach(function(title) {
			var f = fieldsOf(title);
			if(!f || !LIVE[f["llm-status"]] || jobs[title]) { return; }
			if(f["llm-runner"] !== tabId) {
				var ref = lastSign(f);
				if(isNaN(ref) || fresh(ref)) { return; }
			}
			markDead(title, f);
		});
		wiki.filterTiddlers("[all[tiddlers]prefix[" + STOP_PREFIX + "]]").forEach(function(title) {
			var f = placeholder(title.slice(STOP_PREFIX.length));
			if(!f || !LIVE[f["llm-status"]]) { wiki.deleteTiddler(title); }
		});
		wiki.filterTiddlers("[all[tiddlers]prefix[" + RUNNER_PREFIX + "]]").forEach(function(title) {
			if(title === RUNNER_PREFIX + tabId) {
				if(!hasJobs()) { wiki.deleteTiddler(title); }
			} else if(!fresh(heartbeatOf(title.slice(RUNNER_PREFIX.length)))) {
				wiki.deleteTiddler(title);
			}
		});
	};

	// Startup after a reload: the previous instance of this tab is gone for sure.
	api.claimPrevious = function(previousTabId) {
		if(!previousTabId || previousTabId === tabId) { return; }
		wiki.filterTiddlers("[all[tiddlers]field:llm-inline-slot[yes]]").forEach(function(title) {
			var f = fieldsOf(title);
			if(f && LIVE[f["llm-status"]] && f["llm-runner"] === previousTabId) { markDead(title, f); }
		});
		removeIfExists(RUNNER_PREFIX + previousTabId);
	};

	return api;
};

})();

Save-time transformation: AI: marker lines become slot lines + queued placeholders.

\*/
(function() {

"use strict";

var lib = require("$:/plugins/rimir/llm-inline/lib");

var SCOPE_TITLE = "$:/config/rimir/llm-inline/scope-filter";
var SCOPE_DEFAULT = "[!is[system]]";

function isEligibleType(type) {
	return !type || type === "text/vnd.tiddlywiki";
}

/*
Evaluate the scope filter against the NEW fields: temporarily add the new tiddler, then restore the
previous one. A brand-new note is NOT deleted again: the caller (navigator) adds the real tiddler in
the same tick, and a delete would leave a {modified, deleted} change record that confuses listeners.
*/
function inScope(newTiddler, wiki) {
	var title = newTiddler.fields.title;
	var filter = (wiki.getTiddlerText(SCOPE_TITLE, SCOPE_DEFAULT) || "").trim() || SCOPE_DEFAULT;
	var previous = wiki.getTiddler(title);
	try {
		wiki.addTiddler(newTiddler);
		return wiki.filterTiddlers(filter, null, wiki.makeTiddlerIterator([title])).indexOf(title) !== -1;
	} finally {
		if(previous) { wiki.addTiddler(previous); }
	}
}

/*
Placeholders named in old slot lines that are gone now — only those that really are placeholders
of this note (a cloned note's or hand-written slot line must never delete foreign tiddlers).
*/
function ownOrphans(oldText, newText, note, wiki) {
	return lib.orphanedSlots(oldText, newText).filter(function(t) {
		var p = wiki.getTiddler(t);
		return !!p && p.fields["llm-inline-slot"] === "yes" && p.fields["llm-inline-note"] === note;
	});
}

exports.processSave = function(newTiddler, oldTiddler, wiki) {
	var none = {tiddler: newTiddler, created: [], orphans: []};
	var fields = newTiddler.fields;
	if(fields["llm-inline-slot"] || !isEligibleType(fields.type)) {
		return none;
	}
	var text = fields.text || "";
	var oldText = oldTiddler ? (oldTiddler.fields.text || "") : "";
	var markers = lib.findMarkers(text);
	// Only touch the store for the scope check when there is something to do.
	if((!markers.length && !lib.parseSlots(oldText).length) || !inScope(newTiddler, wiki)) {
		return none;
	}
	var orphans = oldTiddler ? ownOrphans(oldText, text, fields.title, wiki) : [];
	var created = [], reserved = lib.parseSlots(text).map(function(s) { return s.title; });
	var now = $tw.utils.stringifyDate(new Date());
	var newText = text;
	markers.forEach(function(m) {
		var t = lib.nextSlotTitle(fields.title, function(x) { return wiki.tiddlerExists(x); }, reserved.concat(created));
		created.push(t);
		newText = lib.replaceLine(newText, m.lineIndex, lib.slotLine(t));
		wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler({
			title: t,
			text: "",
			type: "text/vnd.tiddlywiki",
			"llm-status": "queued",
			"llm-inline-note": fields.title,
			"llm-instruction": m.instruction,
			"llm-inline-slot": "yes",
			created: now,
			modified: now
		}));
	});
	if(!created.length) {
		return {tiddler: newTiddler, created: [], orphans: orphans};
	}
	return {tiddler: new $tw.Tiddler(newTiddler, {text: newText}), created: created, orphans: orphans};
};

})();

title: $:/plugins/rimir/llm-inline/startup
type: application/javascript
module-type: startup

Hooks: th-saving-tiddler (marker transform) and note deletion cleanup; runner timers and messages.

\*/
(function() {

"use strict";

exports.name = "llm-inline-startup";
exports.platforms = ["browser"];
exports.after = ["startup"];
exports.synchronous = true;

var runner = null;
var HEARTBEAT_MS = 10000, SWEEP_MS = 15000;
var TAB_KEY = "rimir-llm-inline-tab";

/*
Tab id handling: a fresh id per page load. The id is put into sessionStorage only on pagehide
(reload/navigation) and taken out again on load, so a reloaded tab learns its previous id and can
mark those jobs interrupted at once, while a duplicated tab never inherits a live tab's id.
*/
function takePreviousTabId() {
	var prev = null;
	try {
		prev = window.sessionStorage.getItem(TAB_KEY);
		window.sessionStorage.removeItem(TAB_KEY);
	} catch(e) { /* storage blocked: fall back to the stale sweep */ }
	return prev;
}
function rememberTabIdOnUnload(tabId) {
	try {
		window.addEventListener("pagehide", function() {
			try { window.sessionStorage.setItem(TAB_KEY, tabId); } catch(e) { /* ignore */ }
		});
		window.addEventListener("pageshow", function(event) {
			// Restored from the back/forward cache: this instance lives on.
			if(event.persisted) { try { window.sessionStorage.removeItem(TAB_KEY); } catch(e) { /* ignore */ } }
		});
	} catch(e) { /* ignore */ }
}

function configText(title) {
	return ($tw.wiki.getTiddlerText(title) || "").trim();
}

function placeholdersOf(note) {
	return $tw.wiki.filterTiddlers("[all[tiddlers]field:llm-inline-slot[yes]]").filter(function(t) {
		return $tw.wiki.getTiddler(t).fields["llm-inline-note"] === note;
	});
}

exports.startup = function() {
	var save = require("$:/plugins/rimir/llm-inline/save");
	var orchestrator = require("$:/plugins/rimir/llm-connect/orchestrator");
	var widgetHelpers = require("$:/plugins/rimir/llm-connect/widget-helpers");
	var toolExecutor = require("$:/plugins/rimir/llm-connect/tool-executor");
	var tabId = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Date.now().toString(36);
	var previousTabId = takePreviousTabId();
	rememberTabIdOnUnload(tabId);

	runner = require("$:/plugins/rimir/llm-inline/runner").createRunner({
		wiki: $tw.wiki,
		tabId: tabId,
		now: function() { return Date.now(); },
		runAction: orchestrator.runAction,
		getProtection: function() { return require("$:/plugins/rimir/llm-inline/lib").withHelpContext(widgetHelpers.resolveProtectionFilter({}), $tw.wiki); },
		buildRunOptions: function() {
			var config = widgetHelpers.resolveProviderConfig(
				configText("$:/config/rimir/llm-inline/provider"),
				configText("$:/config/rimir/llm-inline/model"),
				configText("$:/config/rimir/llm-inline/system-prompt"));
			var toolsFilter = configText("$:/config/rimir/llm-inline/tools");
			return {
				config: config,
				adapter: orchestrator.getAdapter(config.provider),
				toolExecutor: toolExecutor,
				// getToolDefinitions("") would return ALL tools: blank config means no tools.
				tools: toolsFilter ? toolExecutor.getToolDefinitions(toolsFilter) : []
			};
		}
	});
	$tw.rootWidget.addEventListener("tm-llm-inline-run", function(e) { runner.enqueue([e.param]); return false; });
	$tw.rootWidget.addEventListener("tm-llm-inline-stop", function(e) { runner.stop(e.param); return false; });
	// Inline/Remove need the host note the slot is rendered in (paramObject.note).
	function hostOf(e) { return e.paramObject && e.paramObject.note; }
	$tw.rootWidget.addEventListener("tm-llm-inline-inline", function(e) { runner.inline(e.param, hostOf(e)); return false; });
	$tw.rootWidget.addEventListener("tm-llm-inline-remove", function(e) { runner.remove(e.param, hostOf(e)); return false; });
	$tw.wiki.addEventListener("change", function(changes) {
		try { runner.onChange(changes); } catch(err) { console.error("llm-inline: onChange failed", err); }
	});
	setInterval(function() {
		try { runner.heartbeat(); } catch(err) { console.error("llm-inline: heartbeat failed", err); }
	}, HEARTBEAT_MS);
	setInterval(function() {
		try { runner.sweepStale(); } catch(err) { console.error("llm-inline: sweep failed", err); }
	}, SWEEP_MS);
	try { runner.claimPrevious(previousTabId); } catch(err) { console.error("llm-inline: claim failed", err); }
	try { runner.sweepStale(); } catch(err) { console.error("llm-inline: sweep failed", err); }

	$tw.hooks.addHook("th-saving-tiddler", function(newTiddler) {
		try {
			if(!newTiddler) { return newTiddler; }
			var result = save.processSave(newTiddler, $tw.wiki.getTiddler(newTiddler.fields.title), $tw.wiki);
			if(result.created.length || result.orphans.length) {
				setTimeout(function() {
					if(!runner) { return; }
					if(result.created.length) {
						try { runner.enqueue(result.created); } catch(e) { console.error("llm-inline: enqueue failed", e); }
					}
					if(result.orphans.length) {
						try { runner.removeOrphans(result.orphans, newTiddler.fields.title); } catch(e) { console.error("llm-inline: removeOrphans failed", e); }
					}
				}, 0);
			}
			return result.tiddler;
		} catch(e) {
			console.error("llm-inline: save hook failed", e);
			return newTiddler;
		}
	});

	// Note deletion: remember placeholders at delete time, clean up when the change lands.
	var pending = [];
	$tw.hooks.addHook("th-deleting-tiddler", function(tiddler) {
		try {
			if(tiddler && !tiddler.fields["llm-inline-slot"]) {
				var ph = placeholdersOf(tiddler.fields.title);
				if(ph.length) { pending.push({note: tiddler.fields.title, titles: ph}); }
			}
		} catch(e) {
			console.error("llm-inline: delete hook failed", e);
		}
		return tiddler;
	});
	$tw.wiki.addEventListener("change", function(changes) {
		if(!pending.length) { return; }
		var rest = [];
		pending.forEach(function(p) {
			if(changes[p.note] && changes[p.note].deleted) {
				try { if(runner) { runner.removeOrphans(p.titles, p.note); } } catch(e) { console.error("llm-inline: removeOrphans failed", e); }
			} else if(!$tw.wiki.tiddlerExists(p.note) && !changes[p.note]) {
				rest.push(p); // deletion not landed yet
			}
			// else: note still exists (deletion vetoed) -> drop the entry
		});
		pending = rest;
	});
};

})();

"use strict";

describe("llm-inline: lib", function() {

	var lib = require("$:/plugins/rimir/llm-inline/lib");

	var added;
	beforeEach(function() { added = []; });
	afterEach(function() {
		added.forEach(function(t) { $tw.wiki.deleteTiddler(t); });
	});

	it("finds AI: lines with instruction", function() {
		var r = lib.findMarkers("a\nAI: draw it\nb");
		expect(r.length).toBe(1);
		expect(r[0].lineIndex).toBe(1);
		expect(r[0].instruction).toBe("draw it");
		expect(r[0].line).toBe("AI: draw it");
	});

	it("ignores non-instruction AI: text", function() {
		expect(lib.findMarkers("```\nAI: x\n```")).toEqual([]);
		expect(lib.findMarkers("
\nAI: x\n
")).toEqual([]);
		expect(lib.findMarkers("<$codeblock code=\"x\">\nAI: x\n")).toEqual([]);
		expect(lib.findMarkers("foo AI: bar")).toEqual([]);
		expect(lib.findMarkers("AI:")).toEqual([]);
		expect(lib.findMarkers("AI:   ")).toEqual([]);
		// after a closed block it fires again
		expect(lib.findMarkers("```\nx\n```\nAI: y").length).toBe(1);
	});

	it("slot lines round-trip odd titles", function() {
		["Plain/ai/1", "He said \"hi\"/ai/1", "it's \"both\"/ai/2", "a]]b c/ai/3"].forEach(function(t) {
			var parsed = lib.parseSlots("x\n  " + lib.slotLine(t) + "  \ny");
			expect(parsed.length).toBe(1);
			expect(parsed[0].title).toBe(t);
			expect(parsed[0].lineIndex).toBe(1);
		});
		expect(lib.slotLine("A/ai/1")).toBe("<$ai.slot tiddler=\"A/ai/1\"/>");
	});

	it("nextSlotTitle skips existing and reserved", function() {
		var r = lib.nextSlotTitle("N", function(t) { return t === "N/ai/1"; }, ["N/ai/2"]);
		expect(r).toBe("N/ai/3");
	});

	it("replaceLine replaces and removes", function() {
		expect(lib.replaceLine("a\nb\nc", 1, "X")).toBe("a\nX\nc");
		expect(lib.replaceLine("a\nb\nc", 1, null)).toBe("a\nc");
		expect(lib.replaceLine("a\nb\nc", 2, null)).toBe("a\nb");
	});

	it("findSlotLine finds or returns -1", function() {
		var text = "a\n" + lib.slotLine("N/ai/1");
		expect(lib.findSlotLine(text, "N/ai/1")).toBe(1);
		expect(lib.findSlotLine(text, "N/ai/2")).toBe(-1);
	});

	it("buildContext marks active and expands others", function() {
		var note = "intro\n" + lib.slotLine("N/ai/1") + "\n" + lib.slotLine("N/ai/2") + "\n" + lib.slotLine("N/ai/9") + "\nend";
		var slots = {
			"N/ai/1": {instruction: "one", text: "R1", status: "done"},
			"N/ai/2": {instruction: "two", text: "", status: "running"}
		};
		var out = lib.buildContext(note, "N/ai/2", function(t) { return slots[t] || null; });
		expect(out).toContain("AI: one\nR1");
		expect(out).toContain("⟦ACTIVE INSTRUCTION⟧ AI: two ⟦/ACTIVE INSTRUCTION⟧");
		expect(out).not.toContain("N/ai/9");
		expect(out).toContain("intro");
		expect(out).toContain("end");
		var out2 = lib.buildContext(note, "N/ai/1", function(t) { return slots[t] || null; });
		expect(out2).toContain("AI: two\n(pending)");
	});

	it("orphanedSlots", function() {
		var oldT = lib.slotLine("N/ai/1") + "\n" + lib.slotLine("N/ai/2");
		var newT = lib.slotLine("N/ai/2");
		expect(lib.orphanedSlots(oldT, newT)).toEqual(["N/ai/1"]);
	});

	it("isTitleProtected", function() {
		$tw.wiki.addTiddler({title: "LLI-sens", tags: ["sensitive"]});
		$tw.wiki.addTiddler({title: "LLI-plain"});
		added.push("LLI-sens", "LLI-plain");
		var deny = {filter: "[tag[sensitive]]", mode: "deny"};
		expect(lib.isTitleProtected("LLI-sens", deny, $tw.wiki)).toBe(true);
		expect(lib.isTitleProtected("LLI-plain", deny, $tw.wiki)).toBe(false);
		expect(lib.isTitleProtected("LLI-plain", {filter: "", mode: "deny"}, $tw.wiki)).toBe(false);
		var allow = {filter: "[[X]]", mode: "allow"};
		expect(lib.isTitleProtected("X", allow, $tw.wiki)).toBe(false);
		expect(lib.isTitleProtected("Y", allow, $tw.wiki)).toBe(true);
	});

	it("isTitleProtected fails closed on a broken filter", function() {
		expect(lib.isTitleProtected("LLI-plain", {filter: "[tag[x", mode: "deny"}, $tw.wiki)).toBe(true);
		expect(lib.isTitleProtected("LLI-plain", {filter: "[is[bogus]]", mode: "deny"}, $tw.wiki)).toBe(true);
		expect(lib.isTitleProtected("LLI-plain", {filter: ":bogus[[LLI-plain]]", mode: "deny"}, $tw.wiki)).toBe(true);
	});

	it("resultText coerces model output to text", function() {
		expect(lib.resultText("abc")).toBe("abc");
		expect(lib.resultText(null)).toBe("");
		expect(lib.resultText(undefined)).toBe("");
		expect(lib.resultText(42)).toBe("42");
		expect(lib.resultText([{type: "text", text: "one"}, {type: "tool_use", id: "x"}, {type: "text", text: "two"}])).toBe("one\n\ntwo");
		expect(lib.resultText(["a", "b"])).toBe("a\n\nb");
		expect(lib.resultText({text: "t"})).toBe("t");
		expect(lib.resultText({content: [{type: "text", text: "c"}]})).toBe("c");
		expect(lib.resultText({foo: 1})).not.toContain("[object Object]");
	});
	it("withHelpContext adds llm-help's default context to the protection", function() {
		var title = "$:/config/rimir/llm-help/default-context";
		var prev = $tw.wiki.getTiddler(title);
		try {
			$tw.wiki.addTiddler({title: title, text: " tw-gotchas\n"});
			var p = lib.withHelpContext({filter: "[[X]]", mode: "deny"}, $tw.wiki);
			expect(p).toEqual({filter: "[[X]]", mode: "deny", helpContext: "tw-gotchas"});
			$tw.wiki.addTiddler({title: title, text: ""});
			expect(lib.withHelpContext({filter: "", mode: "deny"}, $tw.wiki).helpContext).toBeUndefined();
		} finally {
			if(prev) { $tw.wiki.addTiddler(prev); } else { $tw.wiki.deleteTiddler(title); }
		}
	});
});

type: application/javascript

Tests for llm-inline runner.js (queue, stop, heartbeat, protection).

\*/
"use strict";

describe("llm-inline: runner", function() {

	var runnerMod = require("$:/plugins/rimir/llm-inline/runner");
	var SYNC = "$:/config/SyncPollingInterval";
	var ORPHANS = "$:/config/rimir/llm-inline/delete-orphans";
	var clock, calls, runners, created, savedOrphans, savedSync;

	function tick() { return Promise.resolve().then(function() {}).then(function() {}).then(function() {}); }
	function field(t, f) { var x = $tw.wiki.getTiddler(t); return x ? x.fields[f] : undefined; }
	function addPh(title, note, extra) {
		created.push(title);
		$tw.wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler({title: title, text: "", type: "text/vnd.tiddlywiki",
			"llm-inline-slot": "yes", "llm-inline-note": note, "llm-instruction": "do " + title, "llm-status": "queued"}, extra || {}));
	}
	function addNote(title, text, extra) {
		created.push(title);
		$tw.wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler({title: title, text: text}, extra || {}));
	}
	function fakeController() {
		var listeners = [], c = {signal: {aborted: false, addEventListener: function(n, f) { listeners.push(f); }}};
		c.abort = function() { c.signal.aborted = true; listeners.forEach(function(f) { f(); }); };
		return c;
	}
	var RUNNERS = "$:/rimir/llm-inline/runner/", STOPS = "$:/rimir/llm-inline/stop/", EDITS = "$:/state/rimir/llm-inline/edit/";
	function make(tabId, overrides) {
		var deps = {
			wiki: $tw.wiki, tabId: tabId || "me",
			now: function() { return clock; },
			createAbortController: fakeController,
			runAction: function(options) {
				var call = {options: options};
				call.promise = new Promise(function(res, rej) { call.resolve = res; call.reject = rej; });
				calls.push(call);
				return call.promise;
			},
			getProtection: function() { return {filter: "[tag[sensitive]]", mode: "deny"}; },
			buildRunOptions: function() { return {config: {provider: "prov", model: "mod"}, adapter: {}, toolExecutor: {}, tools: []}; }
		};
		Object.keys(overrides || {}).forEach(function(k) { deps[k] = overrides[k]; });
		var r = runnerMod.createRunner(deps);
		runners.push(r);
		return r;
	}
	function runnerTiddler(id, hb) {
		$tw.wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler({title: RUNNERS + id, "llm-runner": id, "llm-heartbeat": String(hb)}));
	}
	function exists(t) { return $tw.wiki.tiddlerExists(t); }

	beforeEach(function() {
		clock = 1000000; calls = []; runners = []; created = [];
		savedOrphans = $tw.wiki.getTiddler(ORPHANS);
		savedSync = $tw.wiki.getTiddler(SYNC);
		setSync("0");
	});
	function setSync(v) { $tw.wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler({title: SYNC, text: v})); }
	afterEach(function() {
		created.forEach(function(t) { $tw.wiki.deleteTiddler(t); });
		$tw.wiki.filterTiddlers("[all[tiddlers]prefix[$:/rimir/llm-inline/]] [all[tiddlers]prefix[$:/state/rimir/llm-inline/]] [all[tiddlers]prefix[Draft of 'RN']]").forEach(function(t) {
			$tw.wiki.deleteTiddler(t);
		});
		$tw.wiki.deleteTiddler(ORPHANS);
		if(savedOrphans) { $tw.wiki.addTiddler(savedOrphans); }
		$tw.wiki.deleteTiddler(SYNC);
		if(savedSync) { $tw.wiki.addTiddler(savedSync); }
	});

	function setup2() {
		addNote("RN", "<$ai.slot tiddler=\"RN/ai/1\"/>\n<$ai.slot tiddler=\"RN/ai/2\"/>");
		addPh("RN/ai/1", "RN");
		addPh("RN/ai/2", "RN");
	}

	it("runs queued jobs in order, one at a time", function(done) {
		setup2();
		var r = make();
		r.enqueue(["RN/ai/1", "RN/ai/2"]);
		expect(field("RN/ai/2", "llm-status")).toBe("queued");
		expect(field("RN/ai/2", "llm-runner")).toBe("me");
		expect(field("RN/ai/2", "llm-heartbeat")).toBeUndefined();
		expect(field(RUNNERS + "me", "llm-heartbeat")).toBe(String(clock));
		tick().then(function() {
			expect(calls.length).toBe(1);
			expect(field("RN/ai/1", "llm-status")).toBe("running");
			calls[0].resolve("R1");
			return tick();
		}).then(function() {
			expect(calls.length).toBe(2);
			expect(field("RN/ai/1", "llm-status")).toBe("done");
			expect(field("RN/ai/1", "text")).toBe("R1");
			expect(field("RN/ai/1", "llm-model")).toBe("prov/mod");
			calls[1].resolve("R2");
			return tick();
		}).then(function() {
			expect(field("RN/ai/2", "llm-status")).toBe("done");
			expect(field("RN/ai/2", "text")).toBe("R2");
			expect(exists(RUNNERS + "me")).toBe(false);
			done();
		});
	});

	it("second prompt sees first result", function(done) {
		setup2();
		var r = make();
		r.enqueue(["RN/ai/1", "RN/ai/2"]);
		tick().then(function() {
			calls[0].resolve("FIRST-RESULT");
			return tick();
		}).then(function() {
			expect(calls[1].options.prompt).toContain("FIRST-RESULT");
			expect(calls[1].options.prompt).toContain("ACTIVE INSTRUCTION");
			expect(calls[1].options.protectionFilter).toEqual({filter: "[tag[sensitive]]", mode: "deny"});
			expect(calls[1].options.signal).toBeDefined();
			calls[1].resolve("x");
			done();
		});
	});

	it("content-block results are stored as text, never [object Object]", function(done) {
		setup2();

"use strict";

describe("llm-inline: save", function() {

	var save = require("$:/plugins/rimir/llm-inline/save");
	var SCOPE = "$:/config/rimir/llm-inline/scope-filter";
	var titles, savedScope;

	function tid(fields) {
		return new $tw.Tiddler({created: new Date(), modified: new Date()}, fields);
	}
	beforeEach(function() {
		titles = ["N", "N/ai/1", "N/ai/2", "N/ai/3", "$:/foo", "M"];
		savedScope = $tw.wiki.tiddlerExists(SCOPE) && !$tw.wiki.isShadowTiddler(SCOPE) ? $tw.wiki.getTiddler(SCOPE) : null;
	});
	afterEach(function() {
		titles.forEach(function(t) { $tw.wiki.deleteTiddler(t); });
		$tw.wiki.deleteTiddler(SCOPE);
		if(savedScope) { $tw.wiki.addTiddler(savedScope); }
	});

	it("replaces markers with slot lines and creates queued placeholders", function() {
		var r = save.processSave(tid({title: "N", text: "x\nAI: one\nAI: two"}), undefined, $tw.wiki);
		expect(r.tiddler.fields.text).toBe("x\n<$ai.slot tiddler=\"N/ai/1\"/>\n<$ai.slot tiddler=\"N/ai/2\"/>");
		expect(r.created).toEqual(["N/ai/1", "N/ai/2"]);
		var p = $tw.wiki.getTiddler("N/ai/2").fields;
		expect(p["llm-instruction"]).toBe("two");
		expect(p["llm-status"]).toBe("queued");
		expect(p["llm-inline-note"]).toBe("N");
		expect(p["llm-inline-slot"]).toBe("yes");
		expect(p.type).toBe("text/vnd.tiddlywiki");
	});

	it("ignores system and non-wikitext tiddlers", function() {
		var a = tid({title: "$:/foo", text: "AI: x"});
		var b = tid({title: "N", text: "AI: x", type: "text/x-markdown"});
		var ra = save.processSave(a, undefined, $tw.wiki);
		var rb = save.processSave(b, undefined, $tw.wiki);
		expect(ra.tiddler).toBe(a);
		expect(rb.tiddler).toBe(b);
		expect(ra.created).toEqual([]);
		expect(rb.created).toEqual([]);
		expect($tw.wiki.tiddlerExists("N/ai/1")).toBe(false);
	});

	it("scope filter is respected", function() {
		$tw.wiki.addTiddler({title: SCOPE, text: "[tag[ai]]"});
		var plain = tid({title: "N", text: "AI: x"});
		var rp = save.processSave(plain, undefined, $tw.wiki);
		expect(rp.tiddler).toBe(plain);
		expect(rp.created).toEqual([]);
		var tagged = tid({title: "N", text: "AI: x", tags: "ai"});
		var rt = save.processSave(tagged, undefined, $tw.wiki);
		expect(rt.created).toEqual(["N/ai/1"]);
	});

Tests for the $ai.slot widget rendering.

\*/
"use strict";

describe("llm-inline: slot render", function() {

	var created;
	function ph(title, fields) {
		created.push(title);
		$tw.wiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler({
			title: title, "llm-inline-slot": "yes", "llm-inline-note": "T",
			type: "text/vnd.tiddlywiki"
		}, fields));
	}
	// Renders the slot as it appears inside note `host` (default "T", the placeholders' note).
	function render(title, host, preview) {
		var vars = {currentTiddler: host === undefined ? "T" : host};
		if(preview) { vars["tv-tiddler-preview"] = "yes"; }
		return $tw.wiki.renderText("text/html", "text/vnd.tiddlywiki",
			"\\import [all[shadows+tiddlers]tag[$:/tags/Global]]\n\n<$ai.slot tiddler=\"" + title + "\"/>\n\n", {variables: vars});
	}
	function makeWidget(host) {
		var widget = $tw.wiki.makeTranscludeWidget("$:/plugins/rimir/llm-inline/slot", {
			parentWidget: $tw.rootWidget, variables: {tiddler: "T/ai/1", currentTiddler: host}, document: $tw.fakeDocument});
		widget.render($tw.fakeDocument.createElement("div"), null);
		return widget;
	}
	function findBtn(w, cls) {
		if(w.parseTreeNode && w.parseTreeNode.type === "button" && w.getAttribute("class") === "lli-btn " + cls) { return w; }
		for(var i = 0; i < (w.children || []).length; i++) { var r = findBtn(w.children[i], cls); if(r) { return r; } }
		return null;
	}
	beforeEach(function() { created = []; });
	afterEach(function() { created.forEach(function(t) { $tw.wiki.deleteTiddler(t); }); });

	it("running slot shows spinner and stop", function() {
		ph("T/ai/1", {"llm-instruction": "summarise things", "llm-status": "running"});
		var h = render("T/ai/1");
		expect(h).toContain("lli-running");
		expect(h).toContain("lli-spinner");
		expect(h).toContain("lli-stop");
		expect(h).toContain("summarise things");
		expect(h).toContain("data-lli-slot=\"T/ai/1\"");
	});

	it("stopping slot hides stop button", function() {
		ph("T/ai/1", {"llm-instruction": "x", "llm-status": "stopping"});
		var h = render("T/ai/1");
		expect(h).toContain("lli-stopping");
		expect(h).not.toContain("lli-stop\"");
		expect(h).toContain("stopping");
	});

	it("done slot renders block wikitext", function() {
		ph("T/ai/1", {"llm-instruction": "x", "llm-status": "done", text: "!! Head\n\n* a"});
		var h = render("T/ai/1");
		expect(h).toContain("lli-done");
		expect(h).toContain("");
		expect(h).toContain("lli-controls");
		expect(h).not.toMatch(/>\s*(yes|no)\s*]*lli-input|]*>/);
		expect(h).toContain("lli-run");
		expect(h).toContain("lli-cancel");
	});

	it("Inline and Remove send the host note along", function() {
		ph("T/ai/1", {"llm-instruction": "x", "llm-status": "done", text: "r"});
		var got = [], msgs = ["tm-llm-inline-inline", "tm-llm-inline-remove"];
		function listener(e) { got.push([e.type, e.param, e.paramObject && e.paramObject.note]); return false; }
		msgs.forEach(function(m) { $tw.rootWidget.addEventListener(m, listener); });
		try {
			var widget = makeWidget("T");
			["lli-inline", "lli-remove"].forEach(function(cls) { var b = findBtn(widget, cls); b.invokeActions(b, {}); });
		} finally {
			msgs.forEach(function(m) { $tw.rootWidget.removeEventListener(m, listener); });
		}
		expect(got).toEqual([["tm-llm-inline-inline", "T/ai/1", "T"], ["tm-llm-inline-remove", "T/ai/1", "T"]]);
	});

	it("Inline and Remove are hidden outside the slot's own note", function() {
		ph("T/ai/1", {"llm-instruction": "x", "llm-status": "done", text: "r"});
		var h = render("T/ai/1", "T 1");
		expect(h).toContain("lli-rerun");
		expect(h).not.toContain("lli-inline");
		expect(h).not.toContain("lli-remove");
	});

	it("controls are hidden in the editor preview", function() {
		ph("T/ai/1", {"llm-instruction": "x", "llm-status": "done", text: "r"});
		ph("T/ai/2", {"llm-instruction": "x", "llm-status": "running"});
		var h = render("T/ai/1", "T", true);
		expect(h).toContain("lli-done");
		expect(h).not.toContain("lli-controls");
		expect(h).not.toContain("lli-btn");
		h = render("T/ai/2", "T", true);
		expect(h).toContain("lli-spinner");
		expect(h).not.toContain("lli-stop");
	});

	it("a pending stop marker shows stopping instead of the Stop button", function() {
		ph("T/ai/1", {"llm-instruction": "x", "llm-status": "running"});
		created.push("$:/rimir/llm-inline/stop/T/ai/1");
		$tw.wiki.addTiddler({title: "$:/rimir/llm-inline/stop/T/ai/1"});
		var h = render("T/ai/1");
		expect(h).toContain("stopping");
		expect(h).not.toContain("lli-stop\"");
	});

	it("settings jobs table offers Re-run only for finished and Stop only for live jobs", function() {
		var st = ["queued", "running", "stopping", "done", "error", "stopped", "interrupted"];
		st.forEach(function(s, i) { ph("T/ai/" + (i + 1), {"llm-instruction": "x", "llm-status": s}); });
		var h = $tw.wiki.renderTiddler("text/html", "$:/plugins/rimir/llm-inline/settings");
		var rows = h.split("").slice(2);
		var byStatus = {};
		rows.forEach(function(r) {
			var m = /(queued|running|stopping|done|error|stopped|interrupted)<\/td>/.exec(r);
			if(m) { byStatus[m[1]] = {rerun: r.indexOf(">Re-run<") !== -1, stop: r.indexOf(">Stop<") !== -1}; }
		});
		expect(byStatus).toEqual({
			queued: {rerun: false, stop: true}, running: {rerun: false, stop: true}, stopping: {rerun: false, stop: false},
			done: {rerun: true, stop: false}, error: {rerun: true, stop: false},
			stopped: {rerun: true, stop: false}, interrupted: {rerun: true, stop: false}
		});
	});

	it("edit button toggles the state tiddler", function() {
		ph("T/ai/1", {"llm-instruction": "x", "llm-status": "done", text: "r"});
		var st = "$:/state/rimir/llm-inline/edit/T/ai/1";
		created.push(st);
		var widget = $tw.wiki.makeTranscludeWidget("$:/plugins/rimir/llm-inline/slot", {
			parentWidget: $tw.rootWidget, variables: {tiddler: "T/ai/1"}, document: $tw.fakeDocument});
		var c = $tw.fakeDocument.createElement("div");
		widget.render(c, null);
		function findBtn(w) {
			if(w.parseTreeNode && w.parseTreeNode.type === "button" && w.getAttribute("class") === "lli-btn lli-edit") { return w; }
			for(var i = 0; i < (w.children || []).length; i++) { var r = findBtn(w.children[i]); if(r) { return r; } }
			return null;
		}
		function click() {
			var btn = findBtn(widget);
			btn.invokeActions(btn, {});
		}
		expect($tw.wiki.tiddlerExists(st)).toBe(false);
		click();
		expect($tw.wiki.tiddlerExists(st)).toBe(true);
		var ch = {}; ch[st] = {modified: true}; widget.refresh(ch);
		click();
		expect($tw.wiki.tiddlerExists(st)).toBe(false);
	});
});
